summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K for May 2026, attaching its unaudited condensed interim financial statements for Q1 2026, MD&A, and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report of a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, containing no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. It does not effect or propose any extraordinary corporate transaction or event.
